notes.text:
This update for psqlODBC fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-109448: denial of service via integer wraparound in SQLBindParameter (bsc#1285073).
- CVE-2026-120057: large-object read overflows the application buffer (bsc#1289252).
- CVE-2026-120058: row cache overflow when a later FETCH changes the column count (bsc#1289253).
- CVE-2026-120059: driver uses a server-supplied column name as a format string (bsc#1289254).
- CVE-2026-120060: driver does not validate server-supplied counts and lengths (bsc#1289255).
- CVE-2026-120061: ODBC escape parser stack buffer overflow (bsc#1289256).
- CVE-2026-120062: SQL injection through SQLSpecialColumns table and schema names (bsc#1289257).
- CVE-2026-120063: stack buffer overflow when quoting long schema and table names (bsc#1289258).
- CVE-2026-120064: driver does not validate column numbers and row indexes in binding and descriptor functions
  (bsc#1289259).
- CVE-2026-120065: driver does not escape a server-supplied column name in its updatable-cursor queries (bsc#1289260).
- CVE-2026-120066: log files are created with default permissions at a predictable path and follow symbolic links
  (bsc#1289261).
- CVE-2026-120067: stack buffer overflow when reading the keyset (ctid/oid) columns of an updatable cursor
  (bsc#1289262).

Changes for psqlODBC:

- Update to 18.00.0006:
  * https://odbc.postgresql.org/docs/release.html
  * Hardening: SQLSetDescRecW stored a freed buffer and the address
    of a local variable as deferred bound data. It now stores the
    application's pointers, as SQLSetDescRec does.
  * Hardening: SQLColumns returned uninitialized relkind and table
    OID values when the table query returned no rows.
  * Hardening: convert_linefeeds could dereference a NULL pointer
    in one build configuration.
  * Hardening: secure_sscanf limits an over-wide %Ns width,
    msgtowstr checks for a zero buffer length, and the MSDTC
    connect-string append is bounded.
- Update to 18.00.0005:
  * https://odbc.postgresql.org/docs/release.html
  * Fix the placeholder cast being truncated from parameter 1000
    on, which failed with 'type 'timestam' does not exist'.
  * Report the largest column size instead of SQL_NO_TOTAL (-4) as
    COLUMN_SIZE for bytea in SQLGetTypeInfo, which broke bytea
    parameters through MSDASQL.
- Update to 18.00.0004:
  * Fix the result-conversions regression test on big-endian
    systems.
- Update to 18.00.0003:
  * Report SQLSTATE 22003 for out-of-range integer conversions
    instead of silently returning the wrapped low bits.
  * Fix statement level rollback (Protocol=7.4-2) discarding the
    whole transaction on a syntax error.
  * Do not wrap internal queries in a savepoint at
    rollback-on-error level 0 (Protocol=7.4-0), which lost
    transactions on servers without SAVEPOINT support.
  * Redact the database password (ODBC PWD and libpq pqopt
    password) in debug logs.
  * Fix hang on COPY ... FROM STDIN / TO STDOUT: report it as
    unsupported and keep the connection usable.
  * Fix 'infinity'/'-infinity' dates being silently returned as
    today's date.
  * Document the connection string escaping rules.
- Update to 18.00.0002:
  * Use a signed type for the error status.
  * Redact sensitive connection parameters in the driver logs.
  * Fix double free / heap corruption during SQLDisconnect
    cleanup.
  * Clear PGresults from per-query rollback.
  * Validate UTF-16 surrogate pairs before combining them.
  * Pass SQLSetDescRec field values correctly.
  * Avoid reading before leading string literals.
  * Detach freed application descriptors from statements.
  * Reject invalid SQLPutData lengths.
  * Reject overlong cursor names.
  * Fix version reporting.
  * Handle ARD bookmark allocation failure.
  * Validate percent escapes before decoding connection string
    values.
  * Avoid reading past the end of conn_settings.
  * Fix stack buffer overflow in getPrecisionPart().
  * Fix SQLPrimaryKeys to exclude INCLUDE columns from the result.
- Update to 18.00.0000, 18.00.0001 and 17.00.0010:
  * No code changes from 17.00.0009.
- Update to 17.00.0009:
  * Fix the test suite for PostgreSQL 19, where
    standard_conforming_strings is always on.
  * Upgrade the GitHub Actions workflow: use prebuilt PostgreSQL
    binaries, parallel matrix builds and a separate release job.
- Update to 17.00.0008:
  * https://odbc.postgresql.org/docs/release.html
- fix build for SLE-15 by forcing gcc 14
- Update to 16.00.0000:
  * Use autoconf to check for stdbool.h.
- Update to 13.02.0000:
  * Fix a bug of CC_send_query_append() when the
    ignore_roundtrip_time flag is onRemove a mylog() call which is
    a dupilicate of the preceding MYLOG() macro call.
  * Remove REFCUR_SUPPORT, add FetchRefcursors setting.
  * Support fetching results from multiple refcursors.
  * Named parameter binding support
  * Use ODBC 3 column names for the result set of catalog
    functions.
- Update to 13.01.0000:
  * Fix a bug of CC_send_query_append() when the
    ignore_roundtrip_time flag is on.
  * Add a call for SQLDescribeCol() before SQLExecute() to prepare-test.
  * The diff of the result was reported by Mangold Fabian and will be
    fixed in the later commit.
  * Add a *update returning* test case to insertreturning regression test.
  * The diff of the result was reported by Patrick Cheung and will be
    fixed in the later commit.
  * Let SQLDescribeCol() use parsed result when the current executed
    result is NULL.
  * This change fixes the diff of prepare-test regression test reported
    by Mangold Fabian.
  * Let SQLExecute() destroy the old result first.
  * This change fixes the diff of insertreturning-test regression test
    reported by Patrick Cheung.
  * Forget to apply disable_convert_func flag to VARCHAR and LONGVARCHAR.
  * Prioritize DISABLE_KEEPALIVE checkbox over the disable_keepalive
    bit of ExtraOptions.
  * Format check for ExtraOptions of setup dialog.
- Update to 13.00.0000:
  * Add support for CONVERT scalar function.
  * Cope with the case that openssl libraries link msvc runtimes
    other than libraries which psqlodbc or libpq links.
  * Call AC_CHECK_SIZEOF() or AC_CHECK_TYPES() macros at earlier
    stage where LIBS variable isn't set yet.
  * These macros compile and run some programs. On some platforms
    (with some linker options like --no-as-needed in Lnux Gnu linker)
    the programs try to link libraries specified by LIBS variable
    at run time. There are some cases that the programs fail due
    to missing library which is actually not needed and
    AC_CHECK_SIZEOF() returns 0.
  * Fix a compilation error with GCC 10 due to conflicting
    variable names.
  * Patch by Paul Wise.
  * Remove curr_param_result property of StatementClass and
    separate parsed result from the exec result.
  * Add support for development with VC16(Visual Studio 2019).
  * MSToolsVersion parameter of BuildAll.ps1 and of regress.ps1
    are deprecated.
  * Hold the first and last result for parametrized SQL statements
    with array of parameters.
  * This would improve the performance of bulk inserts/updates etc.
  * Revise the handling of QResultClass list.
  * Introduce macros QR_concat(), QR_detach() and QR_next().
  * Correct the handling of SQL_ROW_ERROR and SQL_ROW_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO.
  * Remove the single table restriction in SC_set_SS_columnkey.
  * Improve error reporting about SC_pos_reload_needed().
- Update to 12.02.0000:
  * Add a new *Display Optional Error Message* option.
    This option allows to display error messages other than primary
    one. Also add documentaition about the option and
    *Numeric as* option.
  * Handle notice messages in libpq_bind_and_exec().
    Sets and resets a notify receiver around PQexecParams() or
    PQexecPrepared().
  * Ignore PQtransactionStatus PQTRANS_ACTIVE in
    LIBPQ_update_transaction_status(). PQTRANS_ACTIVE isn't a
    transaction status.
  * Improve execution of parameterized SQL statements with arrays
    of parameters by sending chunks of SQL statements.
    If SQL_ATTR_CURSOR_TYPE of an statement is
    SQL_CURSOR_FORWARD_ONLY, SQL_ATTR_CONCURRENCY is
    SQL_CONCUR_READ_ONLY and extended protocol isn't used, the
    batch execution of the statement is possible. A new option
    Batch Size was introduced for such cases.
    Batch Size: Split an array (of parameters) into chunks of
    Batch Size to execute statements. The last chunk may contain
    less than Batch Size elements. Setting 1 to this option forces
    the current one by one execution.
    Also turn off use_server_side_prepare option temporarily when
    batch executuion is possible.
  * Change SC_execute() so that it returns a return code which is
    not affetced by the preceding results. It's necessary for
    batch execution with arrays of parameters.
  * Add a new option IgnoreTimeout.
  * Some tools issue issue SQLSetStmtAttr(.., SQL_ATTR_QUERY_TIMEOUT,,)
    internally and sometimes it's difficult for users to change the
    timeout value. You can disable the timeout by turning on this option.
  * An improvement for psqlodbc developpers.
    Make it possible to call some shell scripts from other directories.

notes.text: Integer wraparound in psqlODBC SQLBindParameter allows an application, or an attacker who controls how many parameters the application binds on one statement, to corrupt heap memory. psqlODBC stores the binding count in a signed 16-bit field. Binding parameter number 32768 wraps that count to -32768. Binding parameter 32769 then writes about 2.5 MB of zeros starting 1.25 MB before the binding array, which crashes the application or leaves it running on a corrupted heap. Applications that build parameter lists from untrusted input, such as an IN (?, ?, ...) list, are exposed. Versions before psqlODBC 18.00.0005 are affected.

notes.text: psqlODBC copies the reply to a large-object read (loread) into the application's buffer using the length sent by the server, without comparing it to the buffer size. A server not trusted under current SSL settings, or a man-in-the-middle, can return more bytes than the buffer holds and overwrite adjacent memory in the client process with server-chosen bytes. Fetching any large-object column is sufficient to trigger it. Versions before psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

notes.text: When psqlODBC quotes a schema or table name into a 128-byte stack buffer, its length check lets it write up to two bytes past the end of the buffer for a long name. notes.text: For an updatable cursor over a table without OIDs that has an auto-increment int4 column, psqlODBC uses that column to identify rows. It places the column's name, as reported by the server, between double quotes in its keyset queries and in the WHERE clause of its positioned SELECT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements, without doubling any double quote in the name. A column name that contains a double quote therefore changes the SQL that the driver runs with the application's privileges, including which rows a positioned UPDATE or DELETE affects. Any database user who can create a table that the application reads with an updatable cursor can choose such a name, and so can a server not trusted under current SSL settings. Versions before psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

notes.text: For updatable cursors, which are enabled by default, psqlODBC adds hidden ctid and, for tables with OIDs, oid columns to the query. It copies each value into a 32-byte stack buffer using the length the server sent, without checking it against the buffer size, so a value of 32 bytes or more writes past the buffer. A server not trusted under current SSL settings can send such a value. So can any database user who can create a view with its own column named ctid that the application reads with an updatable cursor. Builds with _FORTIFY_SOURCE abort; other builds overwrite adjacent stack memory. Versions before psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.
